description: rmorie: R-only lite version of MORIE. CRAN+rOpenSci focused; strict-business carve with no Python dependencies, slim inst/extdata, security-hardened CI.
rmoriedata: Bundled open-data fixtures for rmorie. Data-only companion package; no exported functions.
rmoriebricklayer: Reproducible data bundles with CKAN resolution, SHA256 + Wayback provenance, schema validation, and synthetic fallback.
noqtis: post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA), ML-KEM and HQC, SHA-2/SHA-3 and sealed file capsules, from the NOQTIS C11 library; built from each GitHub release.
